description: Executable support matrix for rvt-rs. Seeded from honest current capabilities in docs/status.md, docs/supported-profile.md, and ROADMAP.md — not aspirational milestone goals. Do not claim converter-grade typed recovery.

capabilities.name: Open .rvt / .rfa / .rte / .rft CFB containers
capabilities.evidence: reader module; CI open matrix; Q-01 corpus open path
capabilities.notes: Standard OLE/CFB Revit layout. Corrupt, encrypted, or non-CFB inputs fail closed.
capabilities.user_impact: Files can be inspected without Revit.

capabilities.name: Decode Revit truncated-gzip streams
capabilities.evidence: compression; checksum_page_framing; fuzz targets; Finding 1 gated strip on Partitions/Global
capabilities.notes: Formats/Latest stays ungated by default. Writer path has separate audit coverage.
capabilities.user_impact: Internal streams can be read safely.

capabilities.name: Extract BasicFileInfo, PartAtom XML, preview PNG
capabilities.evidence: basic_file_info; part_atom; preview tests
capabilities.notes: Identity, build, GUID, title, OmniClass, and stream preview extraction.
capabilities.user_impact: Users can identify and audit files.

capabilities.name: Parse Formats/Latest schema with field classification
capabilities.evidence: 100% field classification over 2016-2026 family corpus; CI regression gate
capabilities.notes: Class and field structure for developers. Not per-element instance recovery.
capabilities.user_impact: Schema introspection works across the verified family band.

capabilities.name: Read document-level ADocument data
capabilities.evidence: Layer 5a walker; reliable on newer samples
capabilities.notes: Good for diagnostics. Older/project bands need more corpus proof. Not complete model extraction.
capabilities.user_impact: Document metadata aids triage; not a full model read.

capabilities.name: Decode typed elements from real project files
capabilities.evidence: Production iter_elements: ArcWall (2023) + partition MVP Level/Material/Room (+ Floor plan loops on files with no element records) + 2024 ArcWallRectOpening (ElemTable-confirmed ids) + 2024 partition element-record Wall/Door/Window/Column instances (RE-21/#211) and Slab/BuildingPad instances with per-element IFC export overrides (RE-22/#212); RE-19/RE-20 negatives
capabilities.notes: Narrow fail-closed MVP only. Six BuiltInCategories on one Revit 2024 edge match Revit's exporter exactly; generic real-project typed extraction is still not solved. Never mark verified without corpus-backed converter-grade evidence (COR-001).
capabilities.user_impact: Useful recovery on supported subsets; full model conversion is not ready.

capabilities.name: Per-class typed decoder structs
capabilities.evidence: elements::all_decoders() (~81); MVP_TYPED_CLASSES consulted by iter_elements
capabilities.notes: Library building blocks plus production MVP/ArcWall path. Broader registry is not production conversion.
capabilities.user_impact: Developers can compose decoders; users should not read this as full coverage.

capabilities.name: Wall / Door / Window / Column / Slab instance recovery from Revit 2024 partition element records
capabilities.evidence: partition_element_records + partition_schema_mvp::instances_from_partition_category_records / slabs_from_partition_category_records + partition_ifc_export_overrides; tests/project_count_fixtures.rs (IFCWALL 360/360, IFCDOOR 132/132, IFCWINDOW 6/6, IFCCOLUMN 256/256, IFCSLAB 80/80, IFCSHADINGDEVICE 20/20, tolerance 0) and the magnetar-2024-core-interior-slim OctetProof verdict, where entity_counts.IFCWALL / IFCDOOR / IFCWINDOW / IFCCOLUMN / IFCSLAB / IFCSHADINGDEVICE are all inside the claimed surface and rvt-rs, IfcOpenShell and IFClite agree exactly
capabilities.notes: Scope is six BuiltInCategories (OST_Walls, OST_Doors, OST_Windows, OST_Columns, OST_Floors, OST_BuildingPad), one release band (Revit 2024) and one recorded edge. Selection is a direct byte test, not a heuristic: the record must carry no container reference at +0x32 and placement kind 0xffffef7f at +0x42 (RE-21). It supersedes the #204 column rule, whose family-local bbox proxy and highest-ElementId-per-footprint collapse are removed. RE-22 (#212) extended the same rule to slabs and found it already exact there: its 99 OST_Floors selections are all exported (79 IfcSlab + 20 IfcShadingDevice), and the 80th exported slab is an OST_BuildingPad (Pad:Site Pad, ElementId 21975). The IfcSlab / IfcShadingDevice split is a per-instance Revit 'IFC Export As' override read out of the partition parameter block: the UTF-16LE value string with the owning ElementId as a u64 at -0x0dc and again at -0x11e, both required to agree and to be declared in Global/ElemTable. Thirty-one entries pass on this file, naming 21 ids; the 20 that are also placed instances are exactly the export's IFCSHADINGDEVICE Tag set. Only IfcShadingDevice is honoured as an override target — an unrecognised value leaves the element on its class mapping. Where one ElementId is framed more than once, the record with the greatest bounding-box z extent is kept; that agrees with the export's IfcExtrudedAreaSolid.Depth on 79 of 80 slabs (the 80th is exported as two stacked solids summing to it) and changes no wall, door, window or column box. Bodies are the record's own bounding box, not a recovered family profile, wall location curve or floor boundary polygon; for plates the z extent is the real thickness (ProfileResolved stays false). Base/top Level ElementIds stay unbound (#86) and doors/windows are not attached to a host wall (door_window_host_wall_binding). Storey containment comes from the #213 column-derived elevation set: walls, doors and columns bind by their record base, plates by their record top face (Revit hangs a floor below its level) — 51 of 100 plates bind and all 51 agree with the export, none wrongly. Windows never bind: their record base is a sill height, measured 0 of 6. This is not evidence for any other category or release.
capabilities.user_impact: Walls, doors, windows, architectural columns, floor slabs and building pads come out of a Revit 2024 project as placed IFC entities with position, an envelope solid and (for slabs) a measured thickness, matching Revit's own export element for element.

capabilities.name: Storey elevations and containment from Revit 2024 element-record bounding boxes
capabilities.evidence: element_record_storeys + ifc::apply_element_record_storeys; on 2024_Core_Interior.rvt the 256 OST_Columns records carry 11 distinct base elevations (0, 31, 46, 61, 76, 91, 106, 121, 136, 151, 166 ft) and all 11 equal an IfcBuildingStorey.Elevation in the paired Revit export, measured with IfcOpenShell 0.8.5; IfcRelContainedInSpatialStructure 1 -> 11 with 794 of 872 elements bound after #212 (all 256 columns, all 132 doors, 355 of 360 walls, 51 of 100 record-backed plates); tests/fixtures/project-counts/2024-core-interior*.json gate diagnostics.exported.storey_count at 11, tolerance 0
capabilities.notes: Elevations only. The join is elevation equality within 1e-3 ft and fails closed on both a miss and an ambiguity, and the storey set is derived this way only when the recovered Level rows carry no elevation of their own. It does not recover which named Level sits at an elevation - 12 name candidates against 11 measured elevations is not a pairing, and a rank join mislabels (Level 6 at 91 ft where the export puts Level 7) - so storeys are labelled 'Elevation N ft'. Level ElementId binding stays unsupported (#86 / RE-20). Scope is Revit 2024 partition element records: only OST_Columns *supplies* elevations, a restriction measured in RE-21 (doors 11 of 11 also land on storeys, walls 12 of 13 - they add -40 ft at the cost of one non-storey elevation - and windows 0 of 6, because a window base is a sill height). Every record-bodied element *binds* to the column-derived set by exact match. The export's other four storeys (-40, -20, 15, 185.5 ft) carry no column record and are not recovered. Re-measured in RE-22 (#212): plates bind by their record TOP face, not their base — Revit hangs a floor below the level that hosts it, so 0 of 40 distinct slab base elevations is a storey elevation while 51 of 100 plates have a top that equals one, every one of them the storey Revit's own export assigns. Slab records are still not an elevation *source*: their 26 distinct top elevations would add -40 ft and 185.5 ft (two of the four storeys this recovery misses) at the cost of 13 values that are not storey elevations, each 0.1667 ft below a real one, so STOREY_ELEVATION_SOURCE_TYPES stays IFCCOLUMN alone and the count stays 11 (#218).
capabilities.user_impact: Columns from a Revit 2024 project land in storeys at their real elevations instead of all defaulting to the first storey; the storeys are labelled by elevation, not by Revit Level name.

capabilities.name: Schema-field Wall decode (non-ArcWall)
capabilities.evidence: RE-19 negative on magnetar corpora; unchanged by RE-21
capabilities.notes: No fail-closed schema-field Wall / 2024 ArcWall envelope suitable for production decode beyond the gated 2023 ArcWall path. RE-21/#211 recovers Wall instances from a different carrier (the partition element record's BuiltInCategory field, see element-record-instance-recovery); the schema-field mechanism this row names is still unsolved, and diagnostics keep reporting schema_field_wall_instances as unsupported.
capabilities.user_impact: Arbitrary walls are not recovered as typed Walls.

capabilities.name: Typed Door and Window host-wall binding
capabilities.evidence: RE-19: no reliable Door vs Window discriminator in the opening-index bytes; host binding still unrecovered after RE-21
capabilities.notes: RE-21/#211 recovers Door and Window *instances* from the partition element record's BuiltInCategory field (see element-record-instance-recovery) — that carrier is unrelated to RE-19's opening-index discriminator, which stays a negative. What remains unsupported here is the host binding: exported IFCDOOR / IFCWINDOW carry no IfcRelFillsElement / host wall, and the 2024 ArcWallRectOpening index still surfaces only ElemTable-confirmed related ids.
capabilities.user_impact: Doors and windows export as placed entities but are not typed IFC fills/voids of a host wall.

capabilities.name: Floor/Room storey bind via Level ElementIds
capabilities.evidence: RE-20: Level absent from Formats; proximity scans noise-dominated
capabilities.notes: Bind plumbing stays fail-closed / corpus-idle. Floors/Rooms remain Unassigned by evidence.
capabilities.user_impact: Scene-tree storey grouping for Floors/Rooms stays Unassigned.

capabilities.name: AProperty* host parameter joins
capabilities.evidence: Production iter_elements / Global/Latest candidate scans; #35 idle on magnetar corpora
capabilities.notes: Honest empty Parameters row until carriers and host joins are proven.
capabilities.user_impact: Element parameters are not exposed as a completed feature.

capabilities.name: IFC4 export from real Revit project files
capabilities.evidence: Synthetic fixtures validate; 2023 ArcWall IfcWall + partition Level/Floor/Room/Material emission; 2024 record-backed IfcWall / IfcDoor / IfcWindow / IfcColumn / IfcSlab / IfcShadingDevice with placement, envelope solid, measured slab thickness and storey containment; rvt-ifc --mode / --diagnostics
capabilities.notes: Correct writer path exists. Real-file typed inputs remain incomplete. Scaffold success is not typed conversion.
capabilities.user_impact: Valid IFC scaffold and narrow typed subsets; not general RVT-to-IFC.

capabilities.name: Converter-grade production RVT-to-IFC
capabilities.evidence: docs/status.md; ROADMAP out-of-scope until corpus-proven typed elements + geometry
capabilities.notes: Explicit non-claim (COR-001). Do not advertise rvt-rs as a production Revit IFC converter.
capabilities.user_impact: Use Revit/API exporters or wait for MVP milestones when evidence lands.

capabilities.name: Zero-upload browser viewer
capabilities.evidence: GitHub Pages; WASM no-network import gate; File Status / storey grouping
capabilities.notes: Geometry and export readiness reflect decoded coverage. Synthetic fixtures are scaffold-only.
capabilities.user_impact: Useful local inspection without upload.

capabilities.name: Stream-level CFB writer / patch
capabilities.evidence: Always-on gen-fixture + MIT empty.rfa patch corpus; optional Autodesk matrix
capabilities.notes: Controlled stream replacement only. Not semantic Revit editing.
capabilities.user_impact: Useful for forensic/stream patches, not model authoring.

capabilities.name: Semantic Revit field-level editing
capabilities.evidence: ADR-002 semantic write API gate
capabilities.notes: No stable semantic write API until decoder/validation evidence is strong enough.
capabilities.user_impact: Do not expect round-trip model edits.

capabilities.name: Python package (rvt)
capabilities.evidence: CI wheel builds; pytest; maturin/pyo3 bindings
capabilities.notes: Useful for metadata/schema automation. Same honesty bounds as the Rust core.
capabilities.user_impact: Scriptable inspection; not a full converter SDK.

capabilities.name: User-facing rvt-inspect CLI
capabilities.evidence: rvt-inspect human + JSON; export readiness; diagnostics sidecar fields
capabilities.notes: Support triage without Revit internals. Reports align with this matrix.
capabilities.user_impact: Clear health / coverage / next-steps for a single file.

capabilities.name: Community corpus open/schema/scaffold IFC check
capabilities.evidence: docs/corpus-hunt-2026-04-21.md: 222/223 real files pass open → schema → scaffold IFC
capabilities.notes: Proves container/schema/scaffold health. Does not prove typed element recovery.
capabilities.user_impact: Confidence in open/inspect on public samples; not conversion proof.

capabilities.name: Measured export source-coverage fractions (A10)
capabilities.evidence: src/ifc/mod.rs SourceCoverageDiagnostics::measure; docs/export-diagnostics.md
capabilities.notes: A10: exported/geometry fractions measured from diagnostics counts; decoded_element_fraction uses ElemTable header element_count only when walker ≤ declared (fail closed when partition recovers exceed the u16 header). Not converter-grade completeness.
capabilities.user_impact: Diagnostics sidecar reports honest measured fractions when denominators exist; otherwise unset/null.
